The book's thermometer figure gives no exact numbers; the bar heights here are approximate (Venus ≈ 460 °C, Mercury day side ≈ 420 °C, Earth ≈ 15 °C, Mars ≈ −60 °C, Jupiter ≈ −110 °C, Saturn ≈ −140 °C, Uranus ≈ −195 °C, Neptune ≈ −200 °C).

"Venus … one day is almost equal to one year of the Earth": by the book's own table a Venus day is 243 Earth days (about two-thirds of an Earth year, and longer than a Venus year of 225 days). Recorded as printed.
